text:
A box of mass 8.0kg is lifted from the ground and placed on a shelf. The box gains 100J of
potential energy.
The box falls off the shelf. Air resistance can be ignored.
At what speed does the box hit the ground?
A
3.5m/s
B
5.0m/s
C
25m/s
D
28m/s
subject: Physics
